shops.title: Shops
shops.createSubtitle: Fill in the details to create your shop.
shops.coverImageHelp: Shown as a wide banner at the top of your shop page. Use a landscape photo at least 1600 × 530 pixels (about 3:1). Phones show only the middle, so keep the important part centred. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
shops.coverImagePlaceholder: No cover image set — your shop shows a default photo
shops.coverImageTooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB. Please choose a smaller image.
shops.coverImageWrongType: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
shops.ohAtLeastOneDay: At least one day must have opening hours.
shops.paymentsDisconnectConfirm: This will disconnect your Stripe account and take your shop offline. You can reconnect a new account at any time.
shops.goLiveNotReady: Your shop is not ready to go live. Please complete the items below.
shops.statusPauseMessagePlaceholder: e.g. We're closed for the night
shops.accentHelp: Used for buttons and highlights on your storefront.
shops.accentTooLight: Too light to read on white ({{ratio}}:1). Pick a darker colour — at least 3:1.
shops.nameChangePending: Name change to "{{name}}" is pending superadmin approval.
shops.nameChangeMinLength: Name must be at least 3 characters.
shops.nameChangeFailed: Failed to submit name change request.
shops.nameChangeCancelFailed: Failed to cancel name change request.
shops.membersAccessDenied: You don't have permission to access Settings.
shops.taxClassesEmpty: Tax classes for {{country}} are not set up yet.
shops.taxClassesNote: Set by the platform for {{country}}. Dishes get their rate from their category.
shops.menuLanguagesHelp: Your menu is written in {{original}}. Add a language to translate it; untranslated text shows in {{original}}.
shops.dpaCheckbox: I accept the data processing agreement (version {{version}}) on behalf of this restaurant.
shops.dpaLoadError: Could not load the agreement. Try again.
shops.orderAlertsHelp: If nobody accepts an order within 3 minutes, we email your Impressum address and the extra address below. If nobody answers within the time limit, the order is declined automatically and the customer is told.
shops.orderAlertsFailed: Could not save the order alerts.
shops.paymentsOnlineOnly: Customers pay online when they order — by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. The amount is reserved and only taken when the order is accepted. Your restaurant can only go live once Stripe is connected.
shops.orderAlertsAutoAcceptHelp: On by default. Each order is accepted and charged the moment the customer has paid, ready in 20 minutes; the board shows it under "In progress" with one chime. Switch off to accept each order yourself — an order nobody answers is declined after the time limit and the customer is not charged.

orders.soundOff: Sound is off — you will not hear new orders.
orders.wakeLockUnsupported: This browser may let the screen sleep. Set the tablet's auto-lock to Never.
orders.rejectConfirm: Decline order {{ref}}? The customer is told straight away and nothing is charged.
orders.actionFailed: That didn't work — the order may have changed. The list has been refreshed.
orders.releaseFailed: Releasing or refunding the payment failed — we retry every 15 minutes. Stripe said: {{message}}
orders.refundConfirm: Refund {{amount}} for order {{ref}}? The money goes back to the customer's card and a correction invoice is sent. This can't be undone.
orders.refundCorrectionIssued: The customer has been emailed a correction invoice.
orders.refundModeHelp: Choosing items refunds each at its own VAT rate (a drink at 19 %). Use an amount for goodwill refunds that aren't tied to an item.

legal.title: Legal & data
legal.loadError: Could not load the legal settings.
legal.draftBadge: Draft – not reviewed by a lawyer
legal.notLegalAdvice: These notes are guidance, not legal advice.
legal.dpaIntro: You are responsible for your customers' data; we process it on your behalf. This agreement sets out how.
legal.dpaNotAccepted: Not accepted yet — required before you can go live.
legal.dpaNewVersion: A new version ({{version}}) is available. Accept it before you next go live.
legal.dpaConfirm: I accept this agreement on behalf of {{name}}.
legal.dpaOwnerOnly: Only the restaurant owner can accept this agreement.
legal.impressumHelp: The law requires every business website to say who runs it. We build the page from these fields.

f.supervisoryAuthority: Supervisory authority (if your licence requires it)

legal.taxNumberHelp: Your Steuernummer. Printed on invoices only, never shown in the public Impressum.
legal.taxIdMissing: Invoices need a tax number or a VAT ID. Enter one before going live.

termsGuide.1: Who you are — the same business name and address as your Impressum.
termsGuide.2: When the contract is made — usually when you accept the order.
termsGuide.3: Prices — all prices include VAT; any delivery charge or minimum order.
termsGuide.4: Payment — which methods you accept and when payment is due.
termsGuide.5: Collection and delivery — where and when orders are handed over, and what happens if nobody collects.
termsGuide.6: Complaints and disputes — how to reach you, and whether you take part in consumer arbitration. Do not link the EU online dispute platform; it closed on 20 July 2025.

withdrawalGuide.1: Freshly prepared food usually has no right of withdrawal because it spoils quickly — but you must still tell customers that clearly.
withdrawalGuide.2: Items that keep, such as sealed bottled drinks, may be treated differently. Ask your adviser.
withdrawalGuide.3: If any item does carry a right of withdrawal, an online "withdraw from contract" button has been required since 19 June 2026. This platform does not offer one yet.
withdrawalGuide.4: Name the business customers can contact, matching your Impressum.

legal.privacyHelp: Generated from your Impressum and the platform's details. You can add your own section below.
legal.privacyUnavailable: Complete the Impressum to generate the privacy notice.
legal.privacyPlatformMissing: The platform's operator details are not set yet. Please contact support.
legal.dataHelp: Download your menu, orders and customer list at any time. Order notes are never included.
legal.eraseHelp: When a customer asks to be forgotten, enter their email. Their orders stay for your tax records, but their name, email, phone and notes are removed. This cannot be undone.
legal.eraseConfirm: Remove {{email}}'s details from all their orders? This cannot be undone.
legal.ownerOnly: Only the restaurant owner can export data or handle erasure requests.
legal.taxNumberHelp: Printed on your invoices only, never in the public Impressum. Invoices need either this or your VAT ID.
legal.taxIdMissing: Without a tax number or VAT ID, no invoices can be issued and the restaurant can't go live.
